doc: The card for "SOMEBODY ELSE CHANGED THIS RECORD WHILE YOU WERE EDITING IT" (step 67b): a save was refused because the record is not what the person opened. Nothing of his was saved. The card says who and when (the last change the manager recorded), lists WHAT changed, and I offer the two safe ways on: take their version (his edits are dropped), or keep his edits on top of it (a three-way merge: only the fields he changed are his, everything else is theirs, so he cannot put back what they changed).

members.name: errors
doc: I show these under the fields: live errors for the fields the person has been in, server errors after a save.

members.name: allErrors
doc: I use ALL the errors of the record as it stands (not only those shown) to decide the tick or the alert inside a box. Defaults to `errors`.

members.name: datesVisible
doc: True for the HOD of C&IT only: for anybody else I show the dates as a locked card and nothing is sent.

members.name: unlocked
doc: Which sections are OPEN. My rule: from top to bottom, a section opens only when the one above it is complete and right.

members.name: complete
doc: True when the whole record is complete and right, that is, the last step is done.

members.name: original
doc: The person being changed, which I use for the masked "now" hints; null when adding.
